name: Old Horde
summary: Across Draenor and Azeroth, the Old Horde left conquest in its wake. Demonic power drove the orc clans to conquer Draenor and invade Azeroth. Blackhand and then Orgrim Doomhammer led them through the First and Second Wars, until the Alliance of Lordaeron defeated them. Thrall's New Horde now seeks to overcome that legacy, while remnants such as the Dark Horde cling to the bloody past.

sections.title: Rise and Deception
sections.body: Kil'jaeden turned the orc clans toward war before they crossed into Azeroth. Through the warlock Gul'dan and the elder shaman Ner'zhul, the demon lord corrupted the proud, spiritual orcs. As the clans fought, the elemental spirits abandoned them. The orcs cast aside shamanism for warlock magic. Then they drank Mannoroth's blood and gave themselves to bloodlust. They slaughtered the draenei and drained life from their homeland.

sections.title: Invasion of Azeroth
sections.body:
Draenor's withering lands could no longer provide what the Horde needed. Gul'dan and Medivh, a human guardian possessed by demonic power, opened the Dark Portal into Azeroth. The Horde poured through and began the First War against the Kingdom of Stormwind. Warchief Blackhand led them, while Gul'dan's Shadow Council secretly directed events.

Near the war's end, Orgrim Doomhammer slew Blackhand and purged the Shadow Council. He took command, then razed Stormwind to the ground.

sections.title: Collapse and Demonic Hangover
sections.body:
Orgrim Doomhammer led the Horde north across the seas to fight the Second War. There, the Horde joined forces with forest trolls and goblin mercenaries. At the height of the siege of Lordaeron, Gul'dan and his loyalists abandoned the war to seek the Tomb of Sargeras. Betrayed and divided, the Horde was driven back to Blackrock Mountain and crushed by the Alliance of Lordaeron.

The Alliance destroyed the portal and herded surviving orcs into internment camps. As the demonic blood haze faded, lethargy settled over them.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Old Horde and the New Horde?
faq.answer: The Old Horde pursued conquest under demonic corruption, warlock magic, and the influence of the Burning Legion and Gul'dan's Shadow Council. After escaping the internment camps, Thrall established the New Horde. It returned to shamanism and honor, uniting survivors instead of leading an invading army.

Blackhand led the Old Horde during the slaughter of the draenei and most of the First War, though Gul'dan used him as a figurehead. Orgrim Doomhammer slew Blackhand in a duel and took the title of Warchief. He led the Horde through the end of the First War and the Second War.

faq.q: Why did the orcs drink demon blood?
aliases: why did orcs drink fel blood
faq.answer: Gul'dan offered the clan chieftains the blood of Mannoroth, a pit lord, and promised overwhelming power and victory. He concealed that drinking it bound their souls to the Burning Legion and filled them with reckless bloodlust.

Gul'dan founded the Shadow Council, a secret order of warlocks, necrolytes, and assassins. The order controlled Warchief Blackhand and secretly guided the Horde according to the Burning Legion's will, until Orgrim Doomhammer uncovered and purged it.

faq.q: How was the Old Horde defeated?
aliases: how did the old horde lose
faq.answer: During the Second War, Gul'dan abandoned the Horde at the gates of Lordaeron to seek godhood at the Tomb of Sargeras. His departure fractured the army. The Alliance of Lordaeron rallied, drove Doomhammer back to Blackrock Mountain, captured him, and herded the demoralized survivors into internment camps.

faq.q: Do any remnants of the Old Horde still exist?
aliases: is the old horde still around
faq.answer: Yes. Splinter factions such as the Dark Horde, which holds Blackrock Spire under Rend Blackhand, reject Thrall's New Horde and cling to conquest and the old brutal ways. They ally with dragons and forest trolls.

angles.text: As an orc, you inherit the Old Horde's shameful history of demonic slavery and ruin. Thrall strives to overcome that legacy through honor and shamanism.
As a human, you live with the scars of the Old Horde's invasion. It leveled Stormwind City and ravaged the lands of Lordaeron during the First and Second Wars.
As a shaman, you know the Old Horde's rise drove Draenor's elemental spirits to turn from the orcs. Under Thrall's guidance, that spiritual breach has only recently begun to heal.
As a warlock, you know how Gul'dan and his Shadow Council spread warlock magic among the orc clans as they built the Old Horde. They drew on the Burning Legion's corrupting power.
As a member of the Alliance, you stand with a coalition formed to unite the mortal kingdoms against the threat of the Old Horde.
